<!-- pr-reviewer: 86853050d2115e1779c3eec26c8f1852a1dcf54b -->
Needs changes before merge.

The catalog case regenerates, verifies, and posts the committed NC exactly. The decision file explains the two models and the G32 passes.

### Results merged with main

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2883`. No GitHub runner was used.
The trial merge with upstream/main `17b1b2b81c2fc555fdaa3f06dec73000d19d20c7` was clean.
The law check used that main revision's `AGENTS.md`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. `app:example_catalog`: 3 passed, 0 failed. This includes regeneration, verification, and exact NC comparison.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

### Extra suites run

The catalog files are fixtures for two suites. I searched the test sources for readers of `examples/catalog`.

- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 3 passed, 0 failed, through the quick gate.
- `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: FAIL. 0 passed, 1 failed, 1 ignored. `catalog_cases_open_and_frame_cleanly` failed. The screenshot renderer stayed ignored.

Exact failure:

```text
thread 'catalog_cases_open_and_frame_cleanly' (4211) panicked at crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs:119:5:
/home/mikekinney/CamcraftPool/.claude/worktrees/review-2883/examples/catalog/turning/cone-thread/cone-thread.camproj failed to open: cone-thread kept as it is: its linked file model/cone-thread.obj cannot be read (No such file or directory (os error 2))
```

No importer source or STEP fixture changed. The extra kernel STEP and machining mesh suites do not apply.

### Safety checks and mutations

I read the new 1,197-line NC file block by block. No existing golden changed.
Both OBJ meshes have finite coordinates, closed edges, consistent face direction, and positive signed volume.

I repeated these mutations against `turning_cone_thread_case_posts_the_taper_and_the_thread`:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Change `G01 X10.212 Z58.4` to `G01 X12.212 Z58.4` | RED: `is off the taper: -0.14130434782608695` |
| Change all `G32 Z63.9 F1.5` blocks to `G32 Z65.4 F1.5` | RED: `each pass ends at the neck, Z63.9` |
| Restore the committed NC | GREEN: 1 passed |

The mutations were restored. The review worktree has no tracked changes.
No machine or control simulator ran the NC. The documented thread simulation and holder limits remain.

### Requested before merge

1. **[P3] Make the saved model links portable.** `examples/catalog/turning/cone-thread/cone-thread.camproj:87178` saves `model/cone-thread.obj`. Line 25141 saves `model/cone-blank.obj` in the same form. The UI checks these paths from its working directory (`crates/ui/src/model_link_watch.rs:71`). Opening this catalog project therefore reports unreadable linked models. The extra suite fails at `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs:119`. Correct the saved links and the rebuild flow so the project opens from the normal app working directory. Keep the paths portable. Add coverage for this case and make `catalog_render` pass from `crates/ui`. A clean app-only catalog gate does not cover this failure.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
